articles.summary: Ambiq has won a 2022 BIG Awards for Business honor, crowning Charlene Wan, Ambiq’s VP of Branding, Marketing, and Business Relations, as Woman of the Year.
articles.title: Ambiq’s Charlene Wan Named Woman of the Year in BIG Awards for Business

articles.summary: Ambiq introduces neuralSPOT, an open-source AI developer-focused ADK designed for Ambiq’s latest Apollo4 Plus system-on-chip (SoC) family.
articles.title: Ambiq Accelerates the Development of Optimized AI Features with neuralSPOT

articles.summary: Ambiq has won two 2022 Public Relations and Marketing Excellence Awards, including the Executive of the Year for Ambiq’s VP of Branding, Marketing, and Business Relations, Charlene Wan, and the Public Relations Department of the Year award.
articles.title: Ambiq Wins Two 2022 Public Relations and Marketing Excellence Awards

articles.summary: Ambiq won five 2022 MarCom Awards, including three platinum awards for Video/Recruitment, Website/Corporation, and Website Design/Graphics; and two gold awards for Video/Corporate Image and Website/Writing.
articles.title: Ambiq Captures Five 2022 MarCom Awards
